liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Cold Rain & Snow** (1 review): Attendee linked the snowfall outside, with no coats, to the opening Cold Rain and Snow [17]
- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): Reviewer found the Lazy Lightning into Supplication very nice [10]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): Attendee received a free ticket and called it a miracle, matching the song played [15]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer praises Jerry's playing in Eyes, with many notes and a high skimming passage around seven minutes [8]
- **Iko Iko** (1 other source): Two small cuts, possibly tape flips, occur in Iko at 0:26 and 11:07 [4]
- **The Other One** (1 other source): Minor tape damage affects The Other One on this recording [5]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-01-14.166918.akg220e.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 185 min [1]
- **gd79-01-14.nak300.wiley-miller.18460.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 23 songs; 175 min; rated 2.85/5 by 13 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the audience recording sounds distant, as if captured on a cell phone; Reviewer finds the audience recording quite listenable; Uploader says the original recording was so loud that levels were lowered; some hiss was removed [3][6][10]
- **gd1979-01-14.166209.set2.nakcm300-cp1.seaweed.andrewf.flac2448**: source not stated; 11 songs; 102 min [4]. Said about its sound: Set 2 copy lacks phase inversion, compression and noise reduction; loud PA crackling during I Need a Miracle [4]
- **gd1979-01-14.167287.set1.nakcm300.seaweed-andrewf.flac2448**: source not stated; 12 songs; 73 min [5]. Said about its sound: Loud PA crackling at times; minor tape damage in The Other One [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Keith popped a balloon behind Donna mid-first set; she slapped him and left the stage [7]
- Reviewer says this was the final show before Donna quit the band [7]
- Attendee hitch-hiked to Utica from the Southern Tier in mid-January; it was their second Dead show [10]
- Attendee travelled from Union College via Albany and Amsterdam; roads were icy and they reached Utica before noon [13]
- Attendee drove from Binghamton without tickets during a blizzard; the show was sold out, but a free ticket appeared [15]
- Attendee drank Utica Club beer, took mushrooms, played pool in summer clothes, then it snowed [17]
- Reviewer notes song sequences like Jack-A-Roe, Looks Like Rain, and Lazy Lightning-Supplication closing the set resemble the 2-17-79 show [12]
- Reviewer sees the show as a good but unremarkable start to 1979 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-01-14.166918.akg220e.lamarre.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Doug Lamarre's 1st generation cassettes; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Master Audience Cassettes; AKG 220E mics > Technics 646D cassette deck; Doug Lamarre's 1st generation cassettes [1]. Also: First-generation cassette source from Doug Lamarre, transferred by Charlie Miller, with pitch correction help from Joe B. Jones; A Nakamichi 300/CP1 source supplies patches in the Estimated Prophet to Eyes transition and in Black Peter [1]
- **gd79-01-14.nak300.wiley-miller.18460.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Audience Recording: Nakamichi 300/CP1 [3]
- **gd1979-01-14.166209.set2.nakcm300-cp1.seaweed.andrewf.flac2448**: taped by seaweed; transferred by Andrew F. 10/2023; source: Nakamichi CM300/CP1's > MAC > Lo-Gen tape [4]. Also: Same Nakamichi 300/CP1 recording as ID-18460, from Seaweed and Andrew F., without processing [4]
- **gd1979-01-14.167287.set1.nakcm300.seaweed-andrewf.flac2448**: taped by seaweed1010; transferred by Andrew F. 03/2024; source: Nakamichi CM300/CP1's > MAC > Lo-Gen tape, with thanks to Seaweed1010. [5]. Also: Newly found first-set companion tape to the second-set Nakamichi source, same recording as ID-18460, unprocessed [5]
